TPE vs. Silicone Sex Doll: Which One Is Better for You? (2026 Buying Guide)

September 22, 2026 • 8 min read

TPE and silicone sex dolls can look pretty similar in photos. Pick one up, though, and the difference gets a lot easier to feel.

TPE is softer. Press into the breasts, hips, or thighs, and it gives more. Silicone feels firmer. That firmness helps the face, skin, fingers, and small details keep their shape.

The material also changes what happens after the doll comes home. Cleaning, stains, clothes, storage, and long-term wear all work a little differently.

TPE vs Silicone Sex Dolls: Quick Comparison

TPE vs Silicone: Which Feels More Real?

Realistic means different things to different people. A material can feel good in your hands and still show less detail up close.

A lot of people pick TPE because it feels soft. It compresses easily and has more give around softer parts of the body.

Silicone feels different. It’s usually firmer, so you notice the sculpt more than the softness. The face, hands, and smaller skin details benefit from that.

Face and Skin Details

Look closely at the eyelids, lips, nostrils, jawline, or skin texture. Silicone can hold these small shapes really well.

Fine lines, pores, makeup, and subtle texture also tend to stay clearer when the material keeps its form.

TPE can still look convincing from a normal distance. Up close, it’s easier to see the difference in fine sculpting.

Chest, Hips, and Thighs

TPE feels much more at home here.

The breasts, hips, and thighs compress easily when you touch them, so the body feels softer in your hand. This is one big reason people who care about touch lean toward TPE.

Silicone keeps more of its original shape under pressure. You get less give, but the body shape stays more defined.

Hands, Feet, and Small Details

Hands are a good place to judge how much detail a material can hold.

Fingers, knuckles, nail beds, small creases, and visible veins can stay sharper in silicone, especially on dolls with more detailed sculpting.

TPE feels softer around the hands and feet. The smallest shapes may look a little less crisp when you get close.

TPE Sex Dolls: Pros and Cons

If softness is your top priority, TPE is a strong fit. It also comes with a lower starting price, which helps if this is your first doll and you’re still figuring out what you care about.

Advantages of TPE

TPE feels soft and flexible, especially around the chest, hips, and thighs. It compresses easily and gives the body more movement when you handle it.

The lower entry price is another big draw. You can spend less upfront and still get a doll with a realistic body feel.

Things to Consider

TPE needs more care.

The surface can pick up dye from dark clothing or bedding. Lubricant residue or sweat should be cleaned carefully after use. Some owners also use renewal powder or cornstarch once the doll is fully dry to help with a tacky surface.

Storage matters too. Leaving soft areas under pressure for long periods can affect the shape.

Silicone Sex Dolls: Pros and Cons

Silicone tends to appeal to buyers who look closely at the face and smaller details.

It costs more, and the body usually feels firmer. What you get back is better control over sculpted detail and a surface that usually asks for less day-to-day care.

Advantages of Silicone

Facial features can be more defined, especially around the lips, eyelids, nose, and jaw.

Silicone also holds detailed work well in the hands, feet, skin texture, and other small areas. It usually keeps those shapes more steady as the doll ages.

Cleaning is usually simpler because the surface absorbs less.

Things to Consider

The firmer feel will matter if softness is your first priority.

Price can also jump quickly once you add detailed makeup, implanted hair, visible veins, or other higher-end finishing work.

Care: TPE vs Silicone Sex Dolls

After you buy, cleaning and care become part of your week.

Caring for TPE Dolls

TPE needs to be cleaned carefully after use, then dried well before storage.

Dark fabrics deserve extra attention. New jeans, black lingerie, socks, and heavily dyed bedding can transfer color, sometimes faster than you expect.

Powdering may become part of your routine if the surface starts to feel tacky.

Caring for Silicone Dolls

Silicone usually makes the routine a little easier.

Cleaning is more straightforward, and dye transfer tends to be less of a problem. The doll still needs to dry properly, especially around joints, openings, and implanted hair.

Certain makeup, oils, fabrics, or cleaners can still leave marks. Testing unfamiliar products on a hidden area is a good habit.

Staining, Clothing, and Storage

Clothing can cause more trouble than people expect.

If you plan to leave the doll dressed for long periods, wash new clothing first. Light fabrics are usually the safer choice, especially with TPE.

Storage has its own problems. A doll left on a hard surface or kept in the same folded position for months can develop pressure marks. Softer areas need room, and joints should not stay under unnecessary strain.

Silicone resists some stains better, but you still need to store it with care.

Durability and Long-Term Ownership

How you treat the doll decides how long it lasts.

A TPE doll can stay in good condition for years when the surface is kept clean, stains are handled early, and the body is stored well. Fingers, toes, joints, and areas that stretch during movement need a little more attention because the material is softer.

Silicone usually holds its shape more steadily over time. Fine sculpting also tends to stay clearer because the material moves less.

Rough handling can damage either one.

Silicone vs TPE Sex Doll Cost

TPE usually costs less upfront. If you mainly care about softness and body feel, that lower starting price can make a lot of sense.

Silicone gets more expensive as the finishing becomes more detailed. Faces, implanted hair, hand details, veins, skin texture, and more involved body sculpting all add work to the manufacturing process.

You’ll also pay for a few small things after checkout.

TPE may need powder, more careful clothing choices, stain prevention, and extra attention during storage. Repairs can come up if soft areas stretch or tear.

Silicone needs less day-to-day surface care, though repairs can be more specialized depending on the damage.

Don’t forget your own time. If you use the doll often, a longer cleaning routine starts to matter.

How to Choose Between TPE and Silicone
TPE May Suit You Better If...

Softness matters more to you than fine surface detail.

You also want to keep the starting price lower, and you’re okay spending a little more time on cleaning, powdering, clothing, and storage.

For a first doll, that tradeoff can be pretty reasonable.

Silicone May Suit You Better If...

You pay more attention to the face, hands, skin texture, and sculpted body shape.

It’s also a good fit if you want less day-to-day surface care or plan to keep the same doll for years.

Collectors and photographers often notice the extra face detail right away. Anyone who studies the face up close may feel the same.

What About Hybrid Sex Dolls?

Some dolls use more than one material.

A common setup pairs a silicone head with a TPE body. You get the sharper facial detail of silicone while keeping the softer feel of TPE through the body.

Other combinations vary by manufacturer, so check exactly which parts are made from each material before ordering.

Frequently Asked Questions About TPE vs Silicone Sex Dolls
Which material feels softer, TPE or silicone?

TPE usually feels softer and compresses more easily, especially around the breasts, hips, and thighs.

Which material has better facial detail?

Silicone generally holds smaller sculpted features more clearly. The difference is easiest to see around the eyes, lips, nose, hands, and skin texture.

Which one is easier to clean?

Silicone is usually easier to care for because its surface absorbs less. TPE often needs more attention during cleaning, drying, and surface care.

Does TPE stain more easily?

Yes, TPE can be more sensitive to color transfer from dark fabrics, cosmetics, and some oils. Washing new clothing before use can reduce the risk.

Does silicone last longer than TPE?

Silicone usually has better shape retention over time. Handling, cleaning, storage, and joint care still make a big difference with either material.

Is silicone worth the higher price?

It depends on why you’re paying more. If you care about facial detail, shape retention, and simpler care, you’ll notice the difference most in daily use.

What Are the Most Realistic Sex Dolls?

September 30, 2026 • 6 min read

If you are buying a sex doll for the first time, it can get confusing pretty fast. One product focuses on realistic skin, another highlights implanted hair, soft breasts, heating, a flexible skeleton, or AI features. After looking at a few dolls, you may still be wondering which details actually make a doll look or feel more realistic.

You may notice the face first, but the skin finish, hairline, body proportions, softness, and the way the joints move can matter just as much. Some features mainly change appearance, while others change touch, posing, warmth, or interaction.

In this guide, we will look at those differences one by one, so you can see which details are worth paying attention to when comparing realistic sex dolls.

What Makes a Sex Doll Look Realistic?
Facial Details and Makeup

Natural-looking makeup depends on layered color rather than one flat tone. Softer shading around the eyes, cheeks, nose, and lips gives the face more depth, while sharper color blocks can make the finish look painted on. Facial proportions matter just as much, especially the balance between the eyes, nose, lips, cheeks, and jaw.

Skin Texture, Veins, and Color

Realistic silicone skin should show small surface details instead of looking completely smooth. Fine lines, pores, subtle color changes, and lightly painted veins can add depth. Veins usually look more natural when the color is soft and uneven rather than dark, clean lines sitting on top of the skin.

Implanted Hair vs. Wigs

A wig is easier to replace and restyle, but the edge around the hairline can be more noticeable. Implanted hair is inserted directly into the scalp, so the forehead and temples can look more natural in close-up views. The trade-off is that implanted hair is harder to change and needs more careful maintenance.

Miriam is a useful example of this kind of visual realism. Her softer eye makeup, defined lips, balanced face shape, and blonde styling keep the expression from looking too heavy or artificial. With close-up photos, the eye area, lips, skin finish, and hairline are the details worth showing most.

What Makes a Sex Doll Feel Realistic?
Silicone vs. TPE: What Feels Different?

TPE usually feels softer and gives more under pressure. Silicone tends to feel firmer, but it keeps its shape better and can hold finer surface detail. That is why TPE often feels softer around larger areas like the thighs and hips, while silicone is more often chosen when skin texture and facial definition matter more.

Standard Breasts vs. Gel Breasts

Standard breasts are usually formed from the same silicone or TPE as the body, so they feel firmer and hold their shape well. Gel breasts add a softer core inside the outer layer. They compress more easily, move more independently from the chest, and have more weight and rebound when pressed. That difference is much easier to feel than simply calling one option “soft.”

Flexible Skeleton vs. Basic Joint Movement

The main joints, like the elbows, knees, hips, and shoulders, already allow the doll to bend and hold basic poses. The difference becomes more obvious in smaller or more complex areas. A more flexible shoulder or waist can change the angle of the whole upper body, while detailed hand skeletons add separate joints inside the fingers and thumb so the hand can bend, grip, or rest in a more human-like shape.

Some articulated finger systems use more than 20 movable joints across the hand, while simpler finger structures may rely on wire or tubing without separate joints. More joints give you finer control over each finger instead of bending the whole hand into one general shape.

Zhiyan is a 159cm silicone doll with a fuller chest, defined waist, and rounded hips, so she works well as an example of how body shape and optional upgrades can change the feel. A standard breast keeps a firmer outline, while a gel breast option adds more compression and movement. A more flexible skeleton can also make the same body look less rigid when seated or reclined, especially through the shoulders,

Do Extra Features Make a Sex Doll Feel More Real?
Sound Response

Intelligent moaning adds vocal reactions during use. The sound can change in pace, tone, and intensity, making the response feel connected to touch and movement. Hearing the doll react adds a stronger sense of interaction and makes the experience feel more human.

Automatic Clamping and Suction

Automatic clamping changes the pressure inside the vaginal canal by tightening and releasing during use. Suction creates a pulling sensation and adds pressure changes inside the canal. The mouth can also support automatic oral movement. Heating can warm the mouth or internal areas. Warmth, suction, and changing pressure together create a more active, body-like sensation.

AI Interaction

AI adds conversation, memory, and personal response. You can talk with the doll through your phone, and the system can remember your habits, preferences, and topics you often discuss. The more you use it, the more context it has about you. It can respond based on previous conversations, remember what you like, and build a more personal style of interaction.

 

How to Choose the Most Realistic Sex Doll

If You Care Most About

	

Look For




Facial realism

	

Face sculpt, makeup detail, skin texture, hairline




Body feel

	

Silicone softness, gel breasts, soft body areas




Natural posing

	

Flexible shoulders, waist, hips, articulated fingers




Warmth

	

Heating functions




More interaction

	

Sound response, clamping and suction, AI features

Also check the product photos closely. Full-body images are useful for proportions, while close-ups show the face, skin, hands, feet, and hairline much better. For optional functions, read what each feature actually does before adding it, because different upgrades change different parts of the experience.

 

FAQ
Will the Doll Look Exactly Like the Product Photos?

The face and body shape should match the listed model, but small differences can happen because makeup and finishing are applied by hand. Hair, clothing, lighting, and styling in product photos can also change the overall look, so close-up images and the listed configuration are worth checking before ordering.

Is a More Expensive Doll Always More Realistic?

Not necessarily. Price can increase because of size, extra functions, implanted hair, heating, gel breasts, or other upgrades. A higher price does not automatically mean the face, skin, or body proportions will look more realistic.

Which Upgrades Are Worth Adding for Realism?

It depends on what kind of realism you want. Implanted hair mainly improves the hairline, gel breasts change softness and movement, heating adds warmth, a more flexible skeleton improves posing, and sound or AI features add interaction.

Should I Choose a Fixed or Removable Insert?

A fixed insert gives the body a more seamless look. A removable insert is easier to take out for cleaning and replacement. The better option depends on whether appearance or easier maintenance matters more to you.

Silicone Sex Doll Buying Guide for First-Time Buyers

September 20, 2026 • 5 min read

Buying a silicone sex doll for the first time requires more than choosing a design you like. Material, size, customization, final cost, and storage all affect the overall experience.

Photos show the appearance of a doll, but details such as skin texture, body structure, configuration, and included features determine the final product. This guide covers the key points to check before ordering a silicone sex doll.

Silicone vs TPE Sex Dolls

Silicone and TPE are two common materials used for sex dolls. Each material has different characteristics in appearance, feel, maintenance, and price.

Feature

	

Silicone Sex Dolls

	

TPE Sex Dolls




Appearance

	

Suitable for detailed sculpting, skin texture, and facial details

	

Known for a softer and more flexible appearance




Feel

	

Firmer structure with detailed surface finishing

	

Softer texture with more flexibility




Maintenance

	

Generally easier to clean and maintain

	

Requires more attention during cleaning and storage




Price

	

Usually higher due to material and production process

	

Usually offers a lower starting cost

Silicone

Silicone is often chosen for its detailed appearance and surface quality. It allows manufacturers to create features such as skin texture, facial details, hands, feet, and body contours with high precision.

TPE

TPE is known for its softer feel and flexibility. It is a popular option for buyers who prefer a softer material and a lower initial cost.

How to Choose the Right Size and Weight
Height and Body Measurements

Height alone does not define the overall appearance. Check measurements such as bust, waist, hips, shoulder width, and body proportions before choosing a model.

Different body designs can create different visual proportions even when the height is similar.

Weight and Handling

Weight affects daily handling, including moving, cleaning, dressing, and storage. Choose a size that fits your available space and your ability to handle the doll comfortably.

Storage Space

Before ordering, consider where the doll will be stored and whether the space allows easy movement. Privacy, room access, and storage conditions should be planned in advance.

What Makes a Silicone Sex Doll Look Realistic?

The appearance of a realistic silicone sex doll comes from the combination of surface details, facial features, and body proportions.

Skin Texture and Body Details

Fine skin texture, subtle vein details, realistic hands, feet, and nail details create a more natural appearance. Small details often show the difference between basic designs and carefully crafted models.

Facial Features and Hair

The face is one of the first areas people notice. Eye design, lip shape, eyelashes, eyebrows, makeup, and hairline all influence the overall look.

Implanted hair provides a more integrated hairline appearance, while wigs allow easier hairstyle changes.

Body Proportions

Body balance affects how natural the overall design appears. Proportions such as shoulders, waist, hips, and body curves work together to create the final silhouette.

Explore our silicone sex dolls collection to compare different designs and body styles.

Customization Options Before Ordering

Customization allows buyers to adjust different details according to personal preferences. Some options change appearance, while others affect the final configuration.

Category

	

Available Options




Appearance

	

Eye color, hairstyle, wig, implanted hair, makeup, skin tone, head selection




Body & Structure

	

Body type, breast style, standing feet, skeleton options, body configuration




Functions

	

Heating, intelligent features, electronic upgrades

Appearance options mainly affect the visual style, while body and functional upgrades usually need to be confirmed before production.

View available custom silicone sex doll options before selecting your final configuration.

Confirm Your Doll Configuration Before Purchase

Product images may include optional features. Before placing an order, confirm the exact configuration of your selected model.

Item

	

Check Before Ordering




Body

	

Model, height, material, and body type




Head

	

Selected head option




Hair

	

Wig or implanted hair




Features

	

Included functions and upgrades

Understanding Silicone Sex Doll Price

The final cost of a silicone sex doll depends on more than the base product price.

Cost

	

Includes




Base Doll

	

Standard model configuration




Customization

	

Appearance and functional upgrades




Shipping

	

Delivery cost based on destination




Care Supplies

	

Cleaning and maintenance products

Compare the final delivered cost based on your selected configuration instead of only comparing the listed product price.

Production Time, Shipping and Discreet Delivery

A typical order includes configuration confirmation, production, quality inspection, packaging, and shipping.

Echobae orders usually take around 2–3 weeks from production preparation to delivery. After shipment, delivery generally takes around 3–7 days depending on destination and customs processing.

Customization options and production schedules may affect preparation time. Check our shipping policy for more delivery details.

Discreet Shipping

Orders are shipped in discreet packaging without product images or visible product information on the outside of the package.

Silicone Doll Care and Storage
Cleaning

Use suitable cleaning products and follow the care instructions for your model. After cleaning, remove moisture completely and allow the surface to dry before storage.

For models with heating systems, electronic components, or upgraded functions, avoid exposing those areas to water and follow the specific maintenance instructions.

Storage

Proper storage helps protect the doll from:

Heat

Direct sunlight

Pressure on the same area for long periods

Color transfer from dark fabrics

Read our silicone doll care guide for more maintenance information.

FAQs
What should I consider before buying my first silicone sex doll?

Check the material, size, weight, configuration, customization options, final cost, delivery details, and storage requirements before ordering.

Is silicone better than TPE?

Silicone and TPE offer different advantages. Silicone is often selected for detailed appearance and easier maintenance, while TPE is known for softness and flexibility.

How do I choose the right size silicone sex doll?

Consider height, body proportions, weight, storage space, and how easily you can move and maintain the doll.

What affects the price of a silicone sex doll?

The model, customization options, shipping method, and additional features all affect the final cost.

Which customization options should I choose?

Focus on options that affect the final configuration, such as body style, head selection, implanted hair, and functional upgrades.

How should I store a silicone doll?

Store it in a clean, dry area away from heat, sunlight, pressure, and materials that may transfer color.

Shipping & Delivery

At Echobae, we want every order to arrive safely, privately, and with clear shipping information from the beginning.

All orders are shipped in discreet packaging and include tracking information once dispatched. Available shipping methods and shipping costs depend on the destination, product weight, package size, and selected delivery option.

Discreet, Tracked, and Reliable

Discreet Packaging: All orders are shipped in plain, unbranded packaging with no product information shown on the outside.

Order Tracking: Tracking information will be provided after your order has been shipped.

Shipping Updates: You may receive shipping updates by email depending on the carrier and order status.

Reliable Delivery: We work with established international logistics providers and local delivery partners depending on the destination.

Shipping Methods

We currently offer two main shipping options for eligible orders.

Standard Shipping

Standard Shipping is the more economical option for customers who are comfortable with a longer delivery time.

Estimated shipping time: approximately 30–35 days after dispatch.

Delivery time may vary depending on the destination, customs clearance, local carrier processing, and remote-area delivery conditions.

Express Shipping

Express Shipping is the faster option for customers who prefer shorter delivery times.

Estimated shipping time: approximately 10–14 business days after dispatch.

Depending on the destination and shipping route, final delivery may be completed by FedEx, UPS, DHL, or other local logistics partners.

Shipping Rates

Shipping costs are calculated based on your destination, product weight, package size, and selected shipping method.

The final available shipping options and shipping cost will be shown at checkout before payment.

Additional charges may apply to remote areas or oversized packages.

Production & Processing Time

Some Echobae dolls require production or preparation based on the selected configuration.

Production and processing time are separate from shipping time.

Shipping time begins after the doll has completed production, quality inspection, packaging, and has been handed over to the carrier.

Customized orders may require additional processing time.

Shipping availability may vary by country, region, postal code, product weight, and local shipping restrictions.

If your destination is not available during checkout, please contact us before placing your order.

Delivery Times

Estimated delivery times after dispatch are:

Standard Shipping: approximately 30–35 days

Express Shipping: approximately 10–14 business days

These estimates do not include production or order preparation time.

Actual delivery may take longer due to customs clearance, holidays, carrier delays, severe weather, remote-area delivery, or other circumstances outside our control.

Customs & Taxes

International orders may be subject to customs duties, import taxes, VAT, GST, or other local charges depending on the destination.

Any fees charged by local customs authorities or delivery carriers are determined by the destination country and may vary by order.

If you are unsure whether additional customs charges may apply, please check your local import requirements before placing an order.

Factory Photos Before Shipping

Before shipment, your completed doll may undergo a final quality inspection.

For selected orders, factory photos may be provided before dispatch so you can review the appearance and selected configuration before the product is packed and shipped.

This helps confirm that the order is ready for delivery.

Incorrect or incomplete shipping information may result in delays or additional delivery charges.

Shipping Delays

Shipping may take longer during peak seasons, public holidays, customs inspections, extreme weather, or unexpected carrier disruptions.

If a significant shipping delay occurs, please contact us with your order number and tracking information so we can assist with checking the shipment status.

Damaged or Missing Packages

If your package arrives with visible damage, please take photos or video of the outer packaging before opening it.

If the product is damaged during transportation, please contact us and provide your order number, shipping label, packaging photos, and photos or video of the damaged product.

If tracking has not updated for an extended period or the package appears to be missing, please contact us so we can assist with checking the shipment with the carrier.

Clothing, Wigs & Accessories

Clothing, wigs, jewelry, accessories, and props shown in product images are not automatically included unless they are specifically listed as included on the product page.

Please review the product details and selected configuration before placing your order.

If you have questions about shipping availability, delivery time, or shipping costs, please contact Echobae customer service before placing your order.

Please provide your country, postal code, and product model so we can check the available shipping options for your destination.

3.3 Business Transfers

4. Data Storage and Security
Where Your Data Is Stored

For international orders, cross-border transfers of personal information will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the use of Standard Contractual Clauses where required.

How Long We Keep Your Information

Security Measures

TLS 1.2 or higher encryption (HTTPS) on all order and checkout pages;

Restricted internal access to personal information;

Two-factor authentication for authorized employees with access to sensitive data; and

Separation of customers’ full names and specific product purchase information in unencrypted logs.

No method of transmitting information over the Internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure. If a data breach occurs, we will notify affected users and the appropriate regulatory authorities within the period required by applicable law, where notification is legally required.

Right to Correction:

Right to Object:

Right to Withdraw Consent:

Sex Doll Care

Your doll needs regular care to help extend its lifespan and keep the material in good condition. Once you become familiar with the routine, cleaning and maintenance will become much easier.

Your care kit should include:

Spray bottle

Microfiber towel

Baby powder

Makeup brush

Soft sponge

Baby oil (mineral oil/liquid paraffin based)

Moisturizing cream

Petroleum jelly

When You First Receive Your Doll

The first day with your doll is especially important.

Wash the doll 5–6 times to remove any residue left from the manufacturing process.

Apply mineral oil and allow it to absorb, then apply a light layer of baby powder.

Leave the doll overnight.

The first application of mineral oil and baby powder will help draw out remaining manufacturing residue.

The next day, wash off the powder, apply mineral oil again, allow it to absorb, and apply baby powder once more.

How to Bathe Your Doll

We do not recommend taking the doll directly into the bathroom for washing.

For routine cleaning, you only need a spray bottle, baby powder, a makeup brush, a soft sponge, and a microfiber towel. Place the doll horizontally on a flat, soft surface such as a bed or foam mat.

Cleaning solution:

Mix regular mild hand soap or body wash with water at a ratio of 1:5 in a clean spray bottle.

This can be used as your doll cleaning solution.

Start with the front of the body. Spray the cleaning solution onto the surface and gently wipe the torso, arms, and legs with a soft sponge. Dry the cleaned areas with a microfiber towel, then apply a light layer of baby powder to reduce stickiness and keep the skin smooth.

Cornstarch-based baby powder can be placed in a small container and applied with a makeup brush. Once the front is finished, carefully turn the doll over and repeat the same process on the back.

After washing, some dirt or stubborn residue may remain on the material. Depending on the lighting and skin tone, these marks may not always be easy to see.

Apply a small amount of baby oil to one area at a time and wipe gently in the same direction. Dirt will gradually collect on the surface. Remove it with a microfiber towel and repeat until the area is clean.

Once the entire doll has been cleaned, you may apply another light layer of baby oil and allow it to absorb.

If you plan to oil the doll, always clean the surface first. Residual manufacturing powder can mix with mineral oil and may cause discoloration if absorbed into the material.

How to Care for Your Doll

The genital area and other high-stress areas require additional care.

For TPE dolls, the original care instructions recommend applying a moisturizing cream containing mineral oil, such as NIVEA cream, to the vaginal and groin areas approximately once a week.

Mineral oil helps keep TPE soft and flexible. If the material becomes too dry, it may be more likely to tear or crack.

NIVEA cream may take approximately 6 hours to absorb.

Petroleum jelly and mineral-oil-based moisturizing cream can be used around:

Armpits

Inner and outer elbows

Inner and outer knees

Ankles

Groin area

Skin folds around the thighs

Vaginal area

Baby oil containing mineral oil or liquid paraffin can be used on the rest of the TPE body.

Please note that petroleum jelly, moisturizing cream, and baby oil may remove factory-applied or custom makeup from the face, breasts, and genital area.

Avoid these areas where possible. If oil comes into contact with makeup, do not rub the surface.

Monthly Full-Body Moisturizing

For TPE dolls, conditioning the entire body with mineral oil approximately once a month can help keep the material soft.

Before applying oil, remove any baby powder from the surface.

Apply baby oil to the front of the body and allow approximately 2 hours for absorption. Turn the doll over and repeat the process on the back.

Petroleum jelly may be used on high-friction areas such as the armpits, groin, and vaginal area. It may take approximately 12 hours to fully absorb.

Baby oil is generally more suitable for conditioning the entire body because petroleum jelly and some moisturizing creams contain a higher concentration of mineral oil.

Baby oil can also be used with a cotton swab or small towel to remove dark or sticky marks caused by dust or dirt. Apply a small amount and gently wipe the affected area.

This method does not apply to dye stains transferred from unwashed clothing.

Dark clothing can easily transfer color onto the doll. Wash new clothing before use and change the water repeatedly until it runs clear.

Allow the clothing to dry completely before dressing the doll.

Areas such as the vagina, anus, and mouth require extra cleaning after use.

Using Lubricant

For TPE dolls, the original care instructions allow baby oil or petroleum jelly to be used as lubrication.

If you prefer to use a personal lubricant, choose a water-based lubricant and avoid silicone-based lubricants.

If your doll has a removable vaginal insert:

Apply baby oil to the insert.

Apply a small amount of baby oil or petroleum jelly around the opening.

Gently widen the opening with two to four fingers while supporting the surrounding material.

Align the insert with the opening and carefully slide it into place.

Once the insert is positioned, gently remove your fingers.

A clean and dry insert may fit tightly after lubrication. This is normal.

The insert can remain inside the doll if permitted by the manufacturer. Keeping a spare insert is also recommended.

After use, place a tampon inside the vaginal insert before removing it. This helps absorb remaining fluid and reduces leakage.

Remove the insert, wash it thoroughly, and allow it to dry completely.

Fixed Vagina

A fixed or built-in vagina requires more careful cleaning and drying because the cavity cannot be removed.

An aquarium air pump can be used to circulate air through the internal cavity and help it dry thoroughly.

The original care method also recommends using tampons to absorb remaining moisture:

One tampon in the mouth

Two tampons in the vagina, positioned front and back

Two tampons in the anal cavity, positioned front and back

Tampons absorb moisture, leave relatively little lint, and can be removed easily using the pull string.

After use, two tampons may also be placed inside the vaginal or anal cavity to absorb remaining fluids and lubricant.

Leave them in place for approximately 30 minutes, then remove them and continue cleaning.

For sanitizing, the original instructions recommend applying 3% hydrogen peroxide solution to tampons and placing them inside a clean, dry vaginal or anal cavity.

Leave them in place for approximately 30 minutes, then remove them.

This can be done approximately once a week.

Do not use alcohol on TPE. Alcohol can dry out the material and may cause cracking, brittleness, or permanent damage.

Avoid toy cleaners, disinfectant sprays, disinfectant soaps, and other products containing ingredients that may damage TPE.

With regular cleaning and proper maintenance, your doll can remain in good condition for much longer.

Products to Avoid
Alcohol

Avoid rubbing alcohol, diluted alcohol, and products containing high concentrations of alcohol, including:

Baby wipes containing alcohol

Disinfectant wipes

Cleaning sprays

Disinfectant soaps

Toy cleaners

Alcohol can damage the internal structure of TPE, causing permanent drying, cracking, brittleness, or small structural tears.

If you use perfume, spray it onto clothing or a wig before placing them on the doll.

Never spray perfume directly onto TPE.

Solvents

Avoid strong solvents and solvent-based products, including:

Mineral spirits

Odorless mineral spirits

Paint thinner

Nitro thinner

Cleaning products containing strong solvents

Some alcohol-free wipes may also contain solvents such as ether or chlorine-based compounds.

Solvents can damage the polymer structure of TPE.

Only use TPE repair solvents specifically supplied or approved by the doll manufacturer, and follow the manufacturer's repair instructions.

Vegetable Oils

Avoid creams, soaps, body washes, or other products containing vegetable oils such as coconut oil or fruit oils.

These oils may coat the surface and affect the normal properties of TPE.

TPE vs. Silicone Sex Doll: Which One Is Better for You? (2026 Buying Guide)

September 22, 2026 • 8 min read

TPE and silicone sex dolls can look pretty similar in photos. Pick one up, though, and the difference gets a lot easier to feel.

TPE is softer. Press into the breasts, hips, or thighs, and it gives more. Silicone feels firmer. That firmness helps the face, skin, fingers, and small details keep their shape.

The material also changes what happens after the doll comes home. Cleaning, stains, clothes, storage, and long-term wear all work a little differently.

TPE vs Silicone Sex Dolls: Quick Comparison

TPE vs Silicone: Which Feels More Real?

Realistic means different things to different people. A material can feel good in your hands and still show less detail up close.

A lot of people pick TPE because it feels soft. It compresses easily and has more give around softer parts of the body.

Silicone feels different. It’s usually firmer, so you notice the sculpt more than the softness. The face, hands, and smaller skin details benefit from that.

Face and Skin Details

Look closely at the eyelids, lips, nostrils, jawline, or skin texture. Silicone can hold these small shapes really well.

Fine lines, pores, makeup, and subtle texture also tend to stay clearer when the material keeps its form.

TPE can still look convincing from a normal distance. Up close, it’s easier to see the difference in fine sculpting.

Chest, Hips, and Thighs

TPE feels much more at home here.

The breasts, hips, and thighs compress easily when you touch them, so the body feels softer in your hand. This is one big reason people who care about touch lean toward TPE.

Silicone keeps more of its original shape under pressure. You get less give, but the body shape stays more defined.

Hands, Feet, and Small Details

Hands are a good place to judge how much detail a material can hold.

Fingers, knuckles, nail beds, small creases, and visible veins can stay sharper in silicone, especially on dolls with more detailed sculpting.

TPE feels softer around the hands and feet. The smallest shapes may look a little less crisp when you get close.

TPE Sex Dolls: Pros and Cons

If softness is your top priority, TPE is a strong fit. It also comes with a lower starting price, which helps if this is your first doll and you’re still figuring out what you care about.

Advantages of TPE

TPE feels soft and flexible, especially around the chest, hips, and thighs. It compresses easily and gives the body more movement when you handle it.

The lower entry price is another big draw. You can spend less upfront and still get a doll with a realistic body feel.

Things to Consider

TPE needs more care.

The surface can pick up dye from dark clothing or bedding. Lubricant residue or sweat should be cleaned carefully after use. Some owners also use renewal powder or cornstarch once the doll is fully dry to help with a tacky surface.

Storage matters too. Leaving soft areas under pressure for long periods can affect the shape.

Silicone Sex Dolls: Pros and Cons

Silicone tends to appeal to buyers who look closely at the face and smaller details.

It costs more, and the body usually feels firmer. What you get back is better control over sculpted detail and a surface that usually asks for less day-to-day care.

Advantages of Silicone

Facial features can be more defined, especially around the lips, eyelids, nose, and jaw.

Silicone also holds detailed work well in the hands, feet, skin texture, and other small areas. It usually keeps those shapes more steady as the doll ages.

Cleaning is usually simpler because the surface absorbs less.

Things to Consider

The firmer feel will matter if softness is your first priority.

Price can also jump quickly once you add detailed makeup, implanted hair, visible veins, or other higher-end finishing work.

Care: TPE vs Silicone Sex Dolls

After you buy, cleaning and care become part of your week.

Caring for TPE Dolls

TPE needs to be cleaned carefully after use, then dried well before storage.

Dark fabrics deserve extra attention. New jeans, black lingerie, socks, and heavily dyed bedding can transfer color, sometimes faster than you expect.

Powdering may become part of your routine if the surface starts to feel tacky.

Caring for Silicone Dolls

Silicone usually makes the routine a little easier.

Cleaning is more straightforward, and dye transfer tends to be less of a problem. The doll still needs to dry properly, especially around joints, openings, and implanted hair.

Certain makeup, oils, fabrics, or cleaners can still leave marks. Testing unfamiliar products on a hidden area is a good habit.

Staining, Clothing, and Storage

Clothing can cause more trouble than people expect.

If you plan to leave the doll dressed for long periods, wash new clothing first. Light fabrics are usually the safer choice, especially with TPE.

Storage has its own problems. A doll left on a hard surface or kept in the same folded position for months can develop pressure marks. Softer areas need room, and joints should not stay under unnecessary strain.

Silicone resists some stains better, but you still need to store it with care.

Durability and Long-Term Ownership

How you treat the doll decides how long it lasts.

A TPE doll can stay in good condition for years when the surface is kept clean, stains are handled early, and the body is stored well. Fingers, toes, joints, and areas that stretch during movement need a little more attention because the material is softer.

Silicone usually holds its shape more steadily over time. Fine sculpting also tends to stay clearer because the material moves less.

Rough handling can damage either one.

Silicone vs TPE Sex Doll Cost

TPE usually costs less upfront. If you mainly care about softness and body feel, that lower starting price can make a lot of sense.

Silicone gets more expensive as the finishing becomes more detailed. Faces, implanted hair, hand details, veins, skin texture, and more involved body sculpting all add work to the manufacturing process.

You’ll also pay for a few small things after checkout.

TPE may need powder, more careful clothing choices, stain prevention, and extra attention during storage. Repairs can come up if soft areas stretch or tear.

Silicone needs less day-to-day surface care, though repairs can be more specialized depending on the damage.

Don’t forget your own time. If you use the doll often, a longer cleaning routine starts to matter.

How to Choose Between TPE and Silicone
TPE May Suit You Better If...

Softness matters more to you than fine surface detail.

You also want to keep the starting price lower, and you’re okay spending a little more time on cleaning, powdering, clothing, and storage.

For a first doll, that tradeoff can be pretty reasonable.

Silicone May Suit You Better If...

You pay more attention to the face, hands, skin texture, and sculpted body shape.

It’s also a good fit if you want less day-to-day surface care or plan to keep the same doll for years.

Collectors and photographers often notice the extra face detail right away. Anyone who studies the face up close may feel the same.

What About Hybrid Sex Dolls?

Some dolls use more than one material.

A common setup pairs a silicone head with a TPE body. You get the sharper facial detail of silicone while keeping the softer feel of TPE through the body.

Other combinations vary by manufacturer, so check exactly which parts are made from each material before ordering.

Frequently Asked Questions About TPE vs Silicone Sex Dolls
Which material feels softer, TPE or silicone?

TPE usually feels softer and compresses more easily, especially around the breasts, hips, and thighs.

Which material has better facial detail?

Silicone generally holds smaller sculpted features more clearly. The difference is easiest to see around the eyes, lips, nose, hands, and skin texture.

Which one is easier to clean?

Silicone is usually easier to care for because its surface absorbs less. TPE often needs more attention during cleaning, drying, and surface care.

Does TPE stain more easily?

Yes, TPE can be more sensitive to color transfer from dark fabrics, cosmetics, and some oils. Washing new clothing before use can reduce the risk.

Does silicone last longer than TPE?

Silicone usually has better shape retention over time. Handling, cleaning, storage, and joint care still make a big difference with either material.

Is silicone worth the higher price?

It depends on why you’re paying more. If you care about facial detail, shape retention, and simpler care, you’ll notice the difference most in daily use.

What Are the Most Realistic Sex Dolls?

September 30, 2026 • 6 min read

If you are buying a sex doll for the first time, it can get confusing pretty fast. One product focuses on realistic skin, another highlights implanted hair, soft breasts, heating, a flexible skeleton, or AI features. After looking at a few dolls, you may still be wondering which details actually make a doll look or feel more realistic.

You may notice the face first, but the skin finish, hairline, body proportions, softness, and the way the joints move can matter just as much. Some features mainly change appearance, while others change touch, posing, warmth, or interaction.

In this guide, we will look at those differences one by one, so you can see which details are worth paying attention to when comparing realistic sex dolls.

What Makes a Sex Doll Look Realistic?
Facial Details and Makeup

Natural-looking makeup depends on layered color rather than one flat tone. Softer shading around the eyes, cheeks, nose, and lips gives the face more depth, while sharper color blocks can make the finish look painted on. Facial proportions matter just as much, especially the balance between the eyes, nose, lips, cheeks, and jaw.

Skin Texture, Veins, and Color

Realistic silicone skin should show small surface details instead of looking completely smooth. Fine lines, pores, subtle color changes, and lightly painted veins can add depth. Veins usually look more natural when the color is soft and uneven rather than dark, clean lines sitting on top of the skin.

Implanted Hair vs. Wigs

A wig is easier to replace and restyle, but the edge around the hairline can be more noticeable. Implanted hair is inserted directly into the scalp, so the forehead and temples can look more natural in close-up views. The trade-off is that implanted hair is harder to change and needs more careful maintenance.

Miriam is a useful example of this kind of visual realism. Her softer eye makeup, defined lips, balanced face shape, and blonde styling keep the expression from looking too heavy or artificial. With close-up photos, the eye area, lips, skin finish, and hairline are the details worth showing most.

What Makes a Sex Doll Feel Realistic?
Silicone vs. TPE: What Feels Different?

TPE usually feels softer and gives more under pressure. Silicone tends to feel firmer, but it keeps its shape better and can hold finer surface detail. That is why TPE often feels softer around larger areas like the thighs and hips, while silicone is more often chosen when skin texture and facial definition matter more.

Standard Breasts vs. Gel Breasts

Standard breasts are usually formed from the same silicone or TPE as the body, so they feel firmer and hold their shape well. Gel breasts add a softer core inside the outer layer. They compress more easily, move more independently from the chest, and have more weight and rebound when pressed. That difference is much easier to feel than simply calling one option “soft.”

Flexible Skeleton vs. Basic Joint Movement

The main joints, like the elbows, knees, hips, and shoulders, already allow the doll to bend and hold basic poses. The difference becomes more obvious in smaller or more complex areas. A more flexible shoulder or waist can change the angle of the whole upper body, while detailed hand skeletons add separate joints inside the fingers and thumb so the hand can bend, grip, or rest in a more human-like shape.

Some articulated finger systems use more than 20 movable joints across the hand, while simpler finger structures may rely on wire or tubing without separate joints. More joints give you finer control over each finger instead of bending the whole hand into one general shape.

Zhiyan is a 159cm silicone doll with a fuller chest, defined waist, and rounded hips, so she works well as an example of how body shape and optional upgrades can change the feel. A standard breast keeps a firmer outline, while a gel breast option adds more compression and movement. A more flexible skeleton can also make the same body look less rigid when seated or reclined, especially through the shoulders,

Do Extra Features Make a Sex Doll Feel More Real?
Sound Response

Intelligent moaning adds vocal reactions during use. The sound can change in pace, tone, and intensity, making the response feel connected to touch and movement. Hearing the doll react adds a stronger sense of interaction and makes the experience feel more human.

Automatic Clamping and Suction

Automatic clamping changes the pressure inside the vaginal canal by tightening and releasing during use. Suction creates a pulling sensation and adds pressure changes inside the canal. The mouth can also support automatic oral movement. Heating can warm the mouth or internal areas. Warmth, suction, and changing pressure together create a more active, body-like sensation.

AI Interaction

AI adds conversation, memory, and personal response. You can talk with the doll through your phone, and the system can remember your habits, preferences, and topics you often discuss. The more you use it, the more context it has about you. It can respond based on previous conversations, remember what you like, and build a more personal style of interaction.

 

How to Choose the Most Realistic Sex Doll

If You Care Most About

	

Look For




Facial realism

	

Face sculpt, makeup detail, skin texture, hairline




Body feel

	

Silicone softness, gel breasts, soft body areas




Natural posing

	

Flexible shoulders, waist, hips, articulated fingers




Warmth

	

Heating functions




More interaction

	

Sound response, clamping and suction, AI features

Also check the product photos closely. Full-body images are useful for proportions, while close-ups show the face, skin, hands, feet, and hairline much better. For optional functions, read what each feature actually does before adding it, because different upgrades change different parts of the experience.

 

FAQ
Will the Doll Look Exactly Like the Product Photos?

The face and body shape should match the listed model, but small differences can happen because makeup and finishing are applied by hand. Hair, clothing, lighting, and styling in product photos can also change the overall look, so close-up images and the listed configuration are worth checking before ordering.

Is a More Expensive Doll Always More Realistic?

Not necessarily. Price can increase because of size, extra functions, implanted hair, heating, gel breasts, or other upgrades. A higher price does not automatically mean the face, skin, or body proportions will look more realistic.

Which Upgrades Are Worth Adding for Realism?

It depends on what kind of realism you want. Implanted hair mainly improves the hairline, gel breasts change softness and movement, heating adds warmth, a more flexible skeleton improves posing, and sound or AI features add interaction.

Should I Choose a Fixed or Removable Insert?

A fixed insert gives the body a more seamless look. A removable insert is easier to take out for cleaning and replacement. The better option depends on whether appearance or easier maintenance matters more to you.

Silicone Sex Doll Buying Guide for First-Time Buyers

September 20, 2026 • 5 min read

Buying a silicone sex doll for the first time requires more than choosing a design you like. Material, size, customization, final cost, and storage all affect the overall experience.

Photos show the appearance of a doll, but details such as skin texture, body structure, configuration, and included features determine the final product. This guide covers the key points to check before ordering a silicone sex doll.

Silicone vs TPE Sex Dolls

Silicone and TPE are two common materials used for sex dolls. Each material has different characteristics in appearance, feel, maintenance, and price.

Feature

	

Silicone Sex Dolls

	

TPE Sex Dolls




Appearance

	

Suitable for detailed sculpting, skin texture, and facial details

	

Known for a softer and more flexible appearance




Feel

	

Firmer structure with detailed surface finishing

	

Softer texture with more flexibility




Maintenance

	

Generally easier to clean and maintain

	

Requires more attention during cleaning and storage




Price

	

Usually higher due to material and production process

	

Usually offers a lower starting cost

Silicone

Silicone is often chosen for its detailed appearance and surface quality. It allows manufacturers to create features such as skin texture, facial details, hands, feet, and body contours with high precision.

TPE

TPE is known for its softer feel and flexibility. It is a popular option for buyers who prefer a softer material and a lower initial cost.

How to Choose the Right Size and Weight
Height and Body Measurements

Height alone does not define the overall appearance. Check measurements such as bust, waist, hips, shoulder width, and body proportions before choosing a model.

Different body designs can create different visual proportions even when the height is similar.

Weight and Handling

Weight affects daily handling, including moving, cleaning, dressing, and storage. Choose a size that fits your available space and your ability to handle the doll comfortably.

Storage Space

Before ordering, consider where the doll will be stored and whether the space allows easy movement. Privacy, room access, and storage conditions should be planned in advance.

What Makes a Silicone Sex Doll Look Realistic?

The appearance of a realistic silicone sex doll comes from the combination of surface details, facial features, and body proportions.

Skin Texture and Body Details

Fine skin texture, subtle vein details, realistic hands, feet, and nail details create a more natural appearance. Small details often show the difference between basic designs and carefully crafted models.

Facial Features and Hair

The face is one of the first areas people notice. Eye design, lip shape, eyelashes, eyebrows, makeup, and hairline all influence the overall look.

Implanted hair provides a more integrated hairline appearance, while wigs allow easier hairstyle changes.

Body Proportions

Body balance affects how natural the overall design appears. Proportions such as shoulders, waist, hips, and body curves work together to create the final silhouette.

Explore our silicone sex dolls collection to compare different designs and body styles.

Customization Options Before Ordering

Customization allows buyers to adjust different details according to personal preferences. Some options change appearance, while others affect the final configuration.

Category

	

Available Options




Appearance

	

Eye color, hairstyle, wig, implanted hair, makeup, skin tone, head selection




Body & Structure

	

Body type, breast style, standing feet, skeleton options, body configuration




Functions

	

Heating, intelligent features, electronic upgrades

Appearance options mainly affect the visual style, while body and functional upgrades usually need to be confirmed before production.

View available custom silicone sex doll options before selecting your final configuration.

Confirm Your Doll Configuration Before Purchase

Product images may include optional features. Before placing an order, confirm the exact configuration of your selected model.

Item

	

Check Before Ordering




Body

	

Model, height, material, and body type




Head

	

Selected head option




Hair

	

Wig or implanted hair




Features

	

Included functions and upgrades

Understanding Silicone Sex Doll Price

The final cost of a silicone sex doll depends on more than the base product price.

Cost

	

Includes




Base Doll

	

Standard model configuration




Customization

	

Appearance and functional upgrades




Shipping

	

Delivery cost based on destination




Care Supplies

	

Cleaning and maintenance products

Compare the final delivered cost based on your selected configuration instead of only comparing the listed product price.

Production Time, Shipping and Discreet Delivery

A typical order includes configuration confirmation, production, quality inspection, packaging, and shipping.

Echobae orders usually take around 2–3 weeks from production preparation to delivery. After shipment, delivery generally takes around 3–7 days depending on destination and customs processing.

Customization options and production schedules may affect preparation time. Check our shipping policy for more delivery details.

Discreet Shipping

Orders are shipped in discreet packaging without product images or visible product information on the outside of the package.

Silicone Doll Care and Storage
Cleaning

Use suitable cleaning products and follow the care instructions for your model. After cleaning, remove moisture completely and allow the surface to dry before storage.

For models with heating systems, electronic components, or upgraded functions, avoid exposing those areas to water and follow the specific maintenance instructions.

Storage

Proper storage helps protect the doll from:

Heat

Direct sunlight

Pressure on the same area for long periods

Color transfer from dark fabrics

Read our silicone doll care guide for more maintenance information.

FAQs
What should I consider before buying my first silicone sex doll?

Check the material, size, weight, configuration, customization options, final cost, delivery details, and storage requirements before ordering.

Is silicone better than TPE?

Silicone and TPE offer different advantages. Silicone is often selected for detailed appearance and easier maintenance, while TPE is known for softness and flexibility.

How do I choose the right size silicone sex doll?

Consider height, body proportions, weight, storage space, and how easily you can move and maintain the doll.

What affects the price of a silicone sex doll?

The model, customization options, shipping method, and additional features all affect the final cost.

Which customization options should I choose?

Focus on options that affect the final configuration, such as body style, head selection, implanted hair, and functional upgrades.

How should I store a silicone doll?

Store it in a clean, dry area away from heat, sunlight, pressure, and materials that may transfer color.

Privacy Policy

Our Privacy Commitment: We will never disclose information about your purchases, browsing activity, or interests related to adult products to external marketing platforms, social networks, or third-party data analytics companies.

1. Information We Collect

We collect only the information reasonably necessary to process transactions and provide our services.

1.1 Information You Provide to Us

Account Information:
When you create an account, we may collect your email address and an optional username. We recommend using a username that does not contain your real name if you prefer additional privacy.

Order Information:
We collect the recipient’s name, shipping address, and telephone number as necessary to process and deliver your order.

Payment information is transmitted directly to our payment service providers through encrypted channels. Echobae does not store your complete credit card number or payment account password.

Customer Service Communications:
We may collect information you voluntarily provide when contacting us by email or live chat, including your order number, screenshots, questions, and other information necessary to assist you.

1.2 Information Collected Automatically

Device and Browsing Information:
When you use our Website, we may automatically collect certain technical information, including your IP address, browser type, operating system, access time, and browsing activity, such as the product pages you visit.

Cookies:
We use essential cookies to support functions such as keeping you signed in and remembering items in your shopping cart.

You may disable cookies through your browser settings, although doing so may affect certain Website functions.

1.3 Sensitive Personal Information

We do not intentionally collect highly sensitive personal information such as your sexual preferences or health information.

If you voluntarily provide such information while communicating with our customer service team, we will use it only to respond directly to your request and will anonymize it after the conversation is completed.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your personal information only for specific business and legal purposes.

Purpose

	

How We Use the Information




Order Processing

	

To verify age where required, process payments, arrange delivery, and provide order status updates.




Customer Service

	

To respond to questions about products, returns, exchanges, orders, and age verification.




Fraud Prevention

	

To identify unusual or potentially fraudulent transactions and protect both our customers and the Website.




Service Improvement

	

To analyze anonymized browsing information and improve Website navigation, layout, and product presentation.




Legal Compliance

	

To comply with applicable tax requirements, court orders, law enforcement requests, and other legal obligations.

We will not use your email address or phone number for marketing communications unless you have actively chosen to receive promotional or new-product updates.

You may unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time by using the unsubscribe link provided in the email.

3. How We Share Your Information

We share personal information only when necessary and under the circumstances described below.

3.1 Service Providers

Payment Processors:
We may work with payment providers such as Stripe, PayPal, or local payment gateways. They receive only the information necessary to process your transaction.

Shipping Carriers:
We may provide necessary delivery information, including the recipient’s name, shipping address, and telephone number, to carriers such as DHL, UPS, USPS, or SF Express.

Our agreements with service providers prohibit them from using this information for unrelated purposes.

Age Verification Services:
Where required by applicable law, we may use a third-party service to verify your age, including through identity document verification. Where applicable, such providers are required to delete identification images after the verification process is completed.

3.2 Legal Requirements

We may disclose personal information when we reasonably believe disclosure is necessary to:

Comply with legal proceedings, subpoenas, court orders, or other lawful requests;

Protect the rights or property of Echobae; or

Protect the personal safety of our customers or the public in an emergency.

3.3 Business Transfers

If Echobae is involved in a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or sale of assets, personal information may be transferred as part of that transaction.

Where required, we will notify you before such a transfer and require the receiving party to continue protecting your information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

4. Data Storage and Security
Where Your Data Is Stored

Your personal information is stored on secure servers located in [Country, e.g., United States / Germany / Singapore].

For international orders, cross-border transfers of personal information will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the use of Standard Contractual Clauses where required.

How Long We Keep Your Information

We retain order information for 3 years where necessary to meet tax and accounting requirements.

Account information will be deleted within 30 days after we receive and process a valid account deletion request.

Customer service chat records are automatically anonymized every 90 days.

Security Measures

We use technical and organizational measures designed to protect your personal information, including:

TLS 1.2 or higher encryption (HTTPS) on all order and checkout pages;

Restricted internal access to personal information;

Two-factor authentication for authorized employees with access to sensitive data; and

Separation of customers’ full names and specific product purchase information in unencrypted logs.

No method of transmitting information over the Internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure. If a data breach occurs, we will notify affected users and the appropriate regulatory authorities within the period required by applicable law, where notification is legally required.

5. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on where you live, applicable privacy laws, including the GDPR, CCPA, and PIPL, may provide you with certain rights regarding your personal information.

These may include:

Right of Access:
You may request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.

Right to Correction:
You may request that inaccurate personal information be corrected.

Right to Deletion:
You may request deletion of your account and personal information, subject to information we are legally required to retain, such as certain tax or transaction records.

Right to Restrict Processing:
You may ask us to temporarily restrict certain processing activities, including while the accuracy of your information is being reviewed.

Right to Data Portability:
Where applicable, you may request the personal information you provided to us in a structured, commonly used format.

Right to Object:
Where applicable, you may object to certain processing activities, including certain forms of automated decision-making.

Right to Withdraw Consent:
Where we process your information based on consent, such as for marketing emails, you may withdraw that consent at any time.

How to Exercise Your Rights

Please contact us at support@echobae.com.

To verify your identity, we may ask you to provide information such as your order number or registered email address.

We will respond to verified requests within 30 days, free of charge, unless applicable law permits otherwise.

6. Children’s Privacy

The Website and all products sold by Echobae are intended exclusively for adults.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under the age of 18, or under the applicable legal age of majority in their jurisdiction.

If we discover that we have collected personal information from a minor, we will take steps to delete it promptly.

7. Third-Party Links

Our Website may contain links to third-party websites, including payment gateways, shipment tracking services, or adult community websites that you choose to visit.

These websites operate under their own privacy policies and practices. Echobae is not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or activities of third-party websites.

International Data Transfers

Where required, we use appropriate legal safeguards, such as the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses or other recognized transfer mechanisms.

10. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.

If we make material changes, such as significantly expanding the types of personal information we collect, we will provide notice through the Website or your registered email address at least 30 days before the changes take effect, where required.

The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised “Last Updated” date.

Sex Doll Care

Your doll needs regular care to help extend its lifespan and keep the material in good condition. Once you become familiar with the routine, cleaning and maintenance will become much easier.

Your care kit should include:

Spray bottle

Microfiber towel

Baby powder

Makeup brush

Soft sponge

Baby oil (mineral oil/liquid paraffin based)

Moisturizing cream

Petroleum jelly

When You First Receive Your Doll

The first day with your doll is especially important.

Wash the doll 5–6 times to remove any residue left from the manufacturing process.

Apply mineral oil and allow it to absorb, then apply a light layer of baby powder.

Leave the doll overnight.

The first application of mineral oil and baby powder will help draw out remaining manufacturing residue.

The next day, wash off the powder, apply mineral oil again, allow it to absorb, and apply baby powder once more.

How to Bathe Your Doll

We do not recommend taking the doll directly into the bathroom for washing.

For routine cleaning, you only need a spray bottle, baby powder, a makeup brush, a soft sponge, and a microfiber towel. Place the doll horizontally on a flat, soft surface such as a bed or foam mat.

Cleaning solution:

Mix regular mild hand soap or body wash with water at a ratio of 1:5 in a clean spray bottle.

This can be used as your doll cleaning solution.

Start with the front of the body. Spray the cleaning solution onto the surface and gently wipe the torso, arms, and legs with a soft sponge. Dry the cleaned areas with a microfiber towel, then apply a light layer of baby powder to reduce stickiness and keep the skin smooth.

Cornstarch-based baby powder can be placed in a small container and applied with a makeup brush. Once the front is finished, carefully turn the doll over and repeat the same process on the back.

After washing, some dirt or stubborn residue may remain on the material. Depending on the lighting and skin tone, these marks may not always be easy to see.

Apply a small amount of baby oil to one area at a time and wipe gently in the same direction. Dirt will gradually collect on the surface. Remove it with a microfiber towel and repeat until the area is clean.

Once the entire doll has been cleaned, you may apply another light layer of baby oil and allow it to absorb.

If you plan to oil the doll, always clean the surface first. Residual manufacturing powder can mix with mineral oil and may cause discoloration if absorbed into the material.

How to Care for Your Doll

The genital area and other high-stress areas require additional care.

For TPE dolls, the original care instructions recommend applying a moisturizing cream containing mineral oil, such as NIVEA cream, to the vaginal and groin areas approximately once a week.

Mineral oil helps keep TPE soft and flexible. If the material becomes too dry, it may be more likely to tear or crack.

NIVEA cream may take approximately 6 hours to absorb.

Petroleum jelly and mineral-oil-based moisturizing cream can be used around:

Armpits

Inner and outer elbows

Inner and outer knees

Ankles

Groin area

Skin folds around the thighs

Vaginal area

Baby oil containing mineral oil or liquid paraffin can be used on the rest of the TPE body.

Please note that petroleum jelly, moisturizing cream, and baby oil may remove factory-applied or custom makeup from the face, breasts, and genital area.

Avoid these areas where possible. If oil comes into contact with makeup, do not rub the surface.

Monthly Full-Body Moisturizing

For TPE dolls, conditioning the entire body with mineral oil approximately once a month can help keep the material soft.

Before applying oil, remove any baby powder from the surface.

Apply baby oil to the front of the body and allow approximately 2 hours for absorption. Turn the doll over and repeat the process on the back.

Petroleum jelly may be used on high-friction areas such as the armpits, groin, and vaginal area. It may take approximately 12 hours to fully absorb.

Baby oil is generally more suitable for conditioning the entire body because petroleum jelly and some moisturizing creams contain a higher concentration of mineral oil.

Baby oil can also be used with a cotton swab or small towel to remove dark or sticky marks caused by dust or dirt. Apply a small amount and gently wipe the affected area.

This method does not apply to dye stains transferred from unwashed clothing.

Dark clothing can easily transfer color onto the doll. Wash new clothing before use and change the water repeatedly until it runs clear.

Allow the clothing to dry completely before dressing the doll.

Areas such as the vagina, anus, and mouth require extra cleaning after use.

Using Lubricant

For TPE dolls, the original care instructions allow baby oil or petroleum jelly to be used as lubrication.

If you prefer to use a personal lubricant, choose a water-based lubricant and avoid silicone-based lubricants.

If your doll has a removable vaginal insert:

Apply baby oil to the insert.

Apply a small amount of baby oil or petroleum jelly around the opening.

Gently widen the opening with two to four fingers while supporting the surrounding material.

Align the insert with the opening and carefully slide it into place.

Once the insert is positioned, gently remove your fingers.

A clean and dry insert may fit tightly after lubrication. This is normal.

The insert can remain inside the doll if permitted by the manufacturer. Keeping a spare insert is also recommended.

After use, place a tampon inside the vaginal insert before removing it. This helps absorb remaining fluid and reduces leakage.

Remove the insert, wash it thoroughly, and allow it to dry completely.

Fixed Vagina

A fixed or built-in vagina requires more careful cleaning and drying because the cavity cannot be removed.

An aquarium air pump can be used to circulate air through the internal cavity and help it dry thoroughly.

The original care method also recommends using tampons to absorb remaining moisture:

One tampon in the mouth

Two tampons in the vagina, positioned front and back

Two tampons in the anal cavity, positioned front and back

Tampons absorb moisture, leave relatively little lint, and can be removed easily using the pull string.

After use, two tampons may also be placed inside the vaginal or anal cavity to absorb remaining fluids and lubricant.

Leave them in place for approximately 30 minutes, then remove them and continue cleaning.

For sanitizing, the original instructions recommend applying 3% hydrogen peroxide solution to tampons and placing them inside a clean, dry vaginal or anal cavity.

Leave them in place for approximately 30 minutes, then remove them.

This can be done approximately once a week.

Do not use alcohol on TPE. Alcohol can dry out the material and may cause cracking, brittleness, or permanent damage.

Avoid toy cleaners, disinfectant sprays, disinfectant soaps, and other products containing ingredients that may damage TPE.

With regular cleaning and proper maintenance, your doll can remain in good condition for much longer.

Products to Avoid
Alcohol

Avoid rubbing alcohol, diluted alcohol, and products containing high concentrations of alcohol, including:

Baby wipes containing alcohol

Disinfectant wipes

Cleaning sprays

Disinfectant soaps

Toy cleaners

Alcohol can damage the internal structure of TPE, causing permanent drying, cracking, brittleness, or small structural tears.

If you use perfume, spray it onto clothing or a wig before placing them on the doll.

Never spray perfume directly onto TPE.

Solvents

Avoid strong solvents and solvent-based products, including:

Mineral spirits

Odorless mineral spirits

Paint thinner

Nitro thinner

Cleaning products containing strong solvents

Some alcohol-free wipes may also contain solvents such as ether or chlorine-based compounds.

Solvents can damage the polymer structure of TPE.

Only use TPE repair solvents specifically supplied or approved by the doll manufacturer, and follow the manufacturer's repair instructions.

Vegetable Oils

Avoid creams, soaps, body washes, or other products containing vegetable oils such as coconut oil or fruit oils.

These oils may coat the surface and affect the normal properties of TPE.

Silicone Oil

Avoid silicone oils and silicone-based lubricants on TPE.

Products containing ingredients such as dimethicone may affect the material over time and can contribute to hardening, cracking, brittleness, or shrinkage.
